Use case: stylized-concept. Production game character sprite sheet for a 2.5D office simulation. Single consistent adult person across ALL cells, polished semi-realistic illustrated 3D render matching a friendly office character game, natural adult proportions, navy lanyard and white employee ID. Transparent background, no text, no grid lines, no borders, no ground shadows. Exactly FOUR columns and FIVE rows, equal-size cells, wide spacing within every cell, no overlap. Center each figure in its own cell. Body figures show entire head and both shoes and fit within cell with 8% padding. Camera level, orthographic. Identity and outfit identical in all views.
READING ORDER left to right:
Row1: standing front; standing left profile; standing right profile; standing back.
Row2: walking front; walking right profile; walking back; midway rising from gray office chair (right profile).
Row3: seated typing front with hands extended to an invisible keyboard (NO desk NO laptop); seated typing right profile same; seated typing back same; seated relaxing on simple gray lounge chair front.
Row4: standing sipping a white coffee cup; standing presenting with one hand raised; face portrait neutral; face portrait smiling.
Row5: face portrait focused; face portrait surprised; face portrait thinking; face portrait right profile.
Only gray chair with seated/rising poses, no surrounding furniture. Face portraits show head and shoulders. Soft consistent neutral studio lighting. Subject:
